distro_native_floor_note: PHP branches below the upstream-supported set that ship as the default on a still-supported target OS (8.0 is the base php on AlmaLinux/RHEL 9). Maintained by hand and preserved across php.net auto-refresh; kept in the build-and-test matrix so the versions we ship are proven, even though upstream no longer supports them. See docs/support-matrix.md.
